dm.body:
Quick start:
- {help_cmd} to browse the command list
- {tutorial_cmd} for the tutorial
- {panel_cmd} to open the web panel
If anything comes up, come ask in the [support server]({support_url})!

-# Don't want these messages? Use {joinnotify_cmd} to turn off join notifications.
dm.greeting_inviter: Hey {user}! Thanks for inviting me to {guild}!
dm.greeting_unknown: Hey {user}! Looks like someone invited me to your server {guild} - but I don't have permission to see who it was :/
dm.title_inviter: Oh? Did you just invite me?
dm.title_unknown: Oh? Did someone just invite me?

err.cannot_check_perms: I can't check my permissions in that server right now.
err.follow_forbidden: I don't have permission to set up an update-notification subscription in that channel.
err.missing_channel_perms: I need View Channel and Manage Webhooks in that channel.
err.need_manage_guild: Only members with Manage Server can configure update notifications.
err.pick_channel_in_guild: Please pick a text or announcement channel in this server.
err.subscribe_failed: Something went wrong subscribing to update notifications; please try again later.
err.updates_unavailable: Update notifications can't be subscribed to right now; please try again later.

msg.disabled: Join notifications are off! I won't DM you when you invite me to a server.
msg.enabled: Join notifications are on! I'll DM you a welcome message when you invite me to a server.
msg.subscribed: Bot update notifications will now arrive in {channel}.
msg.update_prompt: Would you like to receive bot update notifications here?

notify_off.desc: I won't notify you again! If you change your mind, use {command} to turn join notifications back on.
notify_off.title: Fair enough

select.other_channel_ph: Or receive them in another channel...
